- Wed 5/26: 09:00-12:00 PT
- Thu 5/27: 13:00-16:00 PT

ApexCloud, Inc.

Subject: Internal: ApexCloud sec review — prep notes

Karthik / Soojin — quick internal note to align before we confirm with Apex:

Agenda (30–40m):
- 5 min quick intros and goals
- 20 min SE demo: auth pattern (SSO/OIDC), network flow, where logs/telemetry live, and short sample call showing latency/throughput for a 1k-token job
- 10–15 min Security Q&A + evidence walkthrough

Karthik: can you prepare
- 10–12 slide deck with architecture diagram + sample request/response timings (include PT/RT cost estimates)
- A 5–7 minute demo plan (call and response)

Soojin: can you bring
- SOC2 scope, KMS/HSM notes, data retention default settings and expected artifacts we can share quickly (policies, redaction approach, audit log example)
- A short evidence checklist PDF I can send as pre-read

I'll confirm slot with the customer once you both confirm availability. If either of you prefer the other Wed slot, tell me now — otherwise I'll aim for Wed 5/26 10:00 PT as first choice.

Thanks — Lauren
